notes.title: Update notes for 25/12/2024
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas! 
[list]
[*] Fixed audio still playing when removing the fishing rod, causing an unbearable audio loop
[*] Fixed fishing pole having collisions with everything, you can no longer slap logs around with it
[*] Hopefully fixed an issue causing negative amounts of seeds 
[*] Removed DLSS as i wasn't using it and it was possibly causing an issue for older GPU's, running the game with -dx11 in the launch options should make the game playable for now, if you're having any issues with launching the game
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for 23/12/2024
notes.notes: small update just to clean some stuff up, adding some content into the files to prepare for another larger update soon. I have a lot of things planned to add/fix, so hopefully i'll get a big old update out soon with some of that in it! :D

notes.title: Update notes for 18/12/2024
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] changed up the main menu - arranged the buttons in a line, near the bottom of the screen, play game is now the largest button, moved the game title to top/middle and added in the background layer of text, music volume now actually works and dynamically adjusts the volume based on the slider, should move this to the settings at some point
[*] campfire overlay text - now has an overlay to ask if you want to "add 3 sticks" just to make it more obvious that you can interact with it
[*] added tree damage sound + log thud sounds when logs hit the floor
[*] sped up the time of day, and set the time of day on begin game to be morning - time of day not saving at the moment though
[*] fishing - added some variations of fish, also made fishing a little bit JUICIER, fish now show up on screen to the scale that you caught them at and come with a plop sound
[*] Trees now make a sound when hit, so decreased the player damage now that there's feedback to the trees being hit. Trees now take 4 hits to destroy, logs take 3 each, eventually this will be dependant based on the tool being used but for that I need to get a hotbar/inventory system sorted 
[*] building menu now shows the required resources to build the item, i'll give this a full graphical overhaul soon but at the moment it functions as needed so it's not too high on my list in terms of priority
[/list]

notes.title: Steamworks and leaderboards fixes
notes.notes:
-Fixed Steamworks integration (you should now be able to alt+tab to get into the steam overlay)
-Fixed Steam leaderboards, now it should update and keep track of who catches the biggest fish

*possible issues with the loading system for resources, it seems to work completely fine while working inside Unreal Engine, but when packaging out it sometimes loads resources into the wrong slot, EG leaving the game with 0 sticks and 10 fish, but loading back into the game with 10 sticks and 0 fish, it seems to be fixed but just wanted to post to say i'm aware of it so if it's happening to you please let me know*

notes.title: Overhaul is coming
notes.notes:
Helloooo. It's been a while since I last posted about remaking the game into something new, and this is a new post to share that progress is being made on it, I think I should be able to get a playable (barebones, but playable) branch uploaded real soon.

I've decided to stick with the idea of what surviving isolation was to begin with, a survival game. However, I'm committed to making it a more playable experience, and as such to begin with I have removed all aspects of multiplayer from the game, though I do really want to include some form of multiplayer in the future, I'm just not sure yet on how I exactly want that implementation to be. 

In general, I'm committed to getting a playable build up soon, and I have a lot of ideas for where to take it over time. As always, your feedback, ideas, suggestions etc are all always welcome, but my next post (hopefully very soon!) will be detailing/sharing much more exciting stuff. :)

notes.title: Price change and where i am with this game
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I just thought I'd post an update to let you all know I've adjusted the price of the game, I couldn't make it free, or take it down from sale so I've had to go with making the game as cheap as possible. I don't recommend that anyone buys the game in it's current state unless you purely want to support me, otherwise I wholeheartedly recommend that instead of purchasing the game, you consider wishlisting or follow the game to keep up to date with updates as they come.

I've also updated the store page to reflect the following information and I'm posting this in an effort to make it as known and honest as possible.

I'm currently not happy with Surviving Isolation, it was a funny idea at the time, it was a great learning experience overall, but it's not a game I'm happy with, it's not something I think is fun beyond maybe an hour or two. Because of this, I'm going to remake surviving isolation into a completely new game, something in a completely different direction that will hopefully be a better product, a better game, and something people will hopefully actually want to play. 

It's going to take some time, I'm still absolutely open to feedback and new ideas, I want to involve people in the creation and development of the game as much as possible. There is a discord available and anyone is welcome to add me or post in the community hub with their ideas and I'll do my best to be as transparent with it as I can, but hopefully the next update, whenever that is, will be a huge update laying some foundations for a much better game overall. 

Thank you to everyone who has purchased, everyone who provided feedback, everyone who playtested and helped me find bugs and come up with ideas.

notes.title: Uploaded the first builds to steam :)
notes.notes:
I've uploaded the first few builds to steam so that everyone with a beta key can now play it and provide any feedback :)

Please also opt in to the beta WIP build you can do this by;

Find surviving isolation in your library
Right click it
Select properties
head to the beta tab
Opt in to the WIP beta

This will keep everyone on the beta WIP for now as that's the one i'm working on, i plan to keep most development in this build and then once it's stable, move everything to the main version in one go :)
